BiblicalUsage: Emaciation is one of the curses Moses sets before a disobedient Israel, a wasting sickness that consumes the eyes and causes sorrow of heart. Leviticus names it beside terror and the burning ague, appointed over a people that would not listen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sickness in the covenant curses was never random, it was the body telling the truth about a broken covenant.
